dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, have you seen the new Korean series?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, hæv juː ˈsiːn ðə ˈnuː kəˈriːən ˈsɪriːz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I watched the first episode last night. I don't think it's very good.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈwɑːtʃt ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈɛpəsoʊd ˈlæst ˈnaɪt. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈθɪŋk ɪts ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The plot is too slow. I don't think I'll watch the next episode.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈplɑːt ɪz ˈtuː ˈsloʊ. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈθɪŋk aɪl ˈwɑːtʃ ðə ˈnɛkst ˈɛpəsoʊd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Where did you watch it? Is it on TV?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛr dɪd juː ˈwɑːtʃ ɪt? ɪz ɪt ɑːn ˌtiːˈviː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it isn't on any channel. I streamed it on my phone.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt ˈɪzənt ɑːn ˈɛni ˈtʃænəl. aɪ ˈstriːmd ɪt ɑːn maɪ ˈfoʊn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good. I don't think I can watch it without subtitles. My Korean is terrible!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈθɪŋk aɪ kən ˈwɑːtʃ ɪt wɪˈðaʊt ˈsʌbtaɪtəlz. maɪ kəˈriːən ɪz ˈtɛrəbəl!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Watch it, then. Maybe you'll like it more than me!
dialogue.reading: ˈwɑːtʃ ɪt, ˈðɛn. ˈmeɪbi juːl ˈlaɪk ɪt ˈmɔːr ðən miː!
